about_the_game:
KOALAS DELIV & GUY is a physics-based, comedy action game!

You are a flying KOALA

And you’ve got the power to unleash a mighty shockwave — the KOALAS WAVE!

Your buddy is NICEGUY, a super-flexible, floppy human.

He's a really good dude.

Your one and only mission:

Use KOALAS WAVE to launch, float, and guide Nice Guy all the way to the goal!

But don’t get cocky —

If Nice Guy goes off-course even once, it’s game over.

No worries, though — you can retry as many times as you like!

Crashes, slips, falls... it won’t be easy.

But Koala and Nice Guy are an unbreakable team.

Trust in your bond and aim for the goal — together!

A flying KOALA...? For real?

・You control a koala that can fly freely through the sky

・You can phase through any object

・You can unleash two kinds of KOALAS WAVE — one light, one strong

So who is this “NICEGUY”?

・He’s super tough — nothing makes him mad, no matter how hard he crashes

・Through intense training, he became a floppy man

・He trusts the koala with all his heart

Controls

  • Direction Buttons (Left Stick): Move the Koala

  • A (B) Button or A (S) Key: Shockwave

  • F Key or Y Button: Open Menu

Note
This game was created with Action Game Maker MV, so Steam achievements are not supported.
